d:
Super delicious, juicy, and crispy, with an incredible mushroom, basil, and cheese filling. I’ve also shown the easiest way to shape them using ready-made wonton sheets, so you can put these together quickly at home.
I fry them in a pan to get that perfect crispy coating while keeping the filling juicy, and serve them with an incredible momo chutney that takes just a few minutes to make. If you want to make the sheets from scratch, I’ve linked my recipe below as well. The full written recipe is mentioned in the description, do give it a try. Happy Cooking!
